title: Single Rotations
mission: Repair the vault with LL and RR rotations
briefing: Time to repair the strain by hand. Drag a child room onto its parent to rotate: dragging a LEFT child up performs a right rotation (fixes LL), dragging a RIGHT child up performs a left rotation (fixes RR). Always repair the deepest strained room first. A wrong rotation jolts the alarm.
hints: A left-heavy room with a left-leaning child is an LL case: drag its LEFT child onto it.
The red badge and the ! mark show the room to repair.
